description: This file defines the Aws\Rds\\nRdsClient class, a client for interacting with Amazon RDS via AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for RDS operations, custom constructor for presigned URL middleware, and internal methods to apply documentation filters related to specific parameters.

classes.name: RdsClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with Amazon RDS, extending AwsClient, including custom middleware setup and internal documentation filter application.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RdsClient with specified arguments, setting up presign URL middleware for certain operations.

methods.name: applyDocFilters
methods.description: Internal static method to modify API documentation shapes for parameters like SourceRegion and DestinationRegion, adding helpful descriptions and handling version-specific differences.
